delegate(uint256,address).details: Delegations take effect at the next epoch (next day boundary). The delegator loses their voting power and the delegatee gains it. Delegations expire when the delegator's lock expires. Delegating to self (same tokenId) is equivalent to no delegation.

params.delegatee_: The wallet address to delegate to (0 for no delegation, same as delegator_ for self-delegation)
params.delegator_: The token ID to delegate from (must be owned by msg.sender)

params.v: The recovery byte of the signature

getPastTotalSupply(uint256).details: Returns the total supply of votes available at a specific moment in the past. If the `clock()` is configured to use block numbers, this will return the value at the end of the corresponding block. NOTE: This value is the sum of all available votes, which is not necessarily the sum of all delegated votes. Votes that have not been delegated are still part of total supply, even though they would not participate in a vote.

params.account_: The account to check voting power for
params.timestamp_: The timestamp to check voting power at (must not be in the future)

returns._totalVotes: The voting power at the given timestamp

returns._0: The current voting power (includes both self votes and delegated votes)

userdoc.notice: Vote delegation system for veHemi tokens. Allows token holders to delegate their voting power to other token holders without transferring ownership. Delegations take effect at the next epoch (next day boundary) and expire when the delegator's lock expires.
